name: kasir-shanti-catering
description: Kasir Shanti Catering web app with Capacitor mobile shells.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:run:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:run:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run ios
